items.exampleEn: My grandfather loves to talk about politics.
Some parents worry about violence in video games.
items.exampleZh: 有些家長擔心電玩遊戲裡的暴力內容。

items.exampleEn: Please be civil, even if you disagree.
items.exampleZh: 即使意見不同，也請保持禮貌。

items.exampleEn: Animals are often the victims of pollution.
items.exampleZh: 動物常常是污染的受害者。

items.exampleEn: Safety comes first at this factory.
items.exampleZh: 這座工廠以安全為第一優先。

items.exampleEn: There is a conflict between my two meetings.
items.exampleZh: 我的兩個會議時間衝突了。

items.exampleEn: We learned about a famous battle in history class.
items.exampleZh: 我們在歷史課學到一場著名的戰役。

items.sentenceEn: My brother wants to study politics.

items.audioEn: Lost property can be collected at the main office until six p.m.
items.audioZh: 遺失物可以在晚上六點前到主辦公室領取。
items.questionZh: 遺失物可以在哪裡領取？
options: At the front gate after six

items.sentenceZh: 暴力從來不是解決的辦法。

items.sentenceEn: She was the victim of an online trick.
items.sentenceZh: 她是網路騙局的受害者。

items.stemEn: Wearing a helmet is important for your ____.
items.stemZh: 戴安全帽對你的安全很重要。

items.stemEn: The two armies fought a ____ near the old castle.
items.stemZh: 兩支軍隊在古堡附近打了一場戰役。

items.passageEn: Two neighbors on my street, Mr. Lee and Mrs. Wu, had a conflict about a tall tree. The tree was on Mr. Lee's property, but its leaves fell into Mrs. Wu's garden. Mr. Lee wanted to preserve the tree, and Mrs. Wu wanted it gone. It felt like a long battle! Still, they stayed civil. There was never any shouting or violence. At first, Mrs. Wu said she felt like a victim. In the end, a friend helped them talk, and they agreed to trim the tree a little for safety. My dad, who never talks about politics, says this is how all problems should be solved.
items.passageZh: 我們街上的兩位鄰居 Lee 先生和 Wu 太太，為了一棵高大的樹起了衝突。那棵樹在 Lee 先生的土地上，但葉子會掉進 Wu 太太的花園。Lee 先生想保留那棵樹，Wu 太太則想把它弄走。感覺像一場漫長的戰役！不過，他們一直保持禮貌，從來沒有大吼大叫或動手。一開始，Wu 太太說她覺得自己是受害者。最後，一位朋友幫他們好好談，他們同意為了安全把樹修剪一點。從不談政治的爸爸說，所有的問題都應該這樣解決。

questions.questionZh: 這兩位鄰居為了什麼起衝突？
最後他們怎麼解決問題？

referenceEn: My sister and I rarely have conflicts.
I rarely have conflicts with my sister.
rubricZh: conflict 表示「衝突」，例如 have conflicts 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 我們的鄰居不太熱情，但至少很有禮貌。
referenceEn: Our neighbor isn't very warm, but he is at least civil.
Our neighbor is not very warm, but at least she is civil.
rubricZh: 用 civil 表示「（至少）有禮貌的」（例如 he is civil；寫 polite 也正確）
「至少」可寫，例如 at least 等；he、she 都可以
